title: Quick Buttery Japanese Rice Bowl
description: A buttery, pillowy rice bowl with a hint of heat, topped with tofu and scallions, served in a stone bowl as a low-glycemic Japanese comfort dish.
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clear.
Combine rice and water in a stone bowl or pot, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 12 minutes until the water is absorbed.
While the rice cooks, melt the butter in a small skillet over medium heat, add the chili powder, and stir for 30 seconds.
Stir in the soy sauce and toasted sesame oil until the mixture is fragrant.
When the rice is ready, fluff it with a fork and transfer it to the bowl.
Pour the butter-chili mixture over the rice and stir until evenly coated.
Sprinkle the toasted sesame seeds and sliced scallions on top, then gently fold in the cubed tofu.
Serve hot, enjoying the buttery texture and subtle heat.
